name: oasis-distribution-reputation
prerequisites: The exact reported download/site, published identity, warning evidence and a suitable vendor channel. Submitting a report needs explicit authority.

scenarios.trigger: Exact known release produces reputation-only warning
scenarios.expected: Prepare factual report with bound file/URL and limited claim.

scenarios.trigger: Downloaded bytes differ from release digest
scenarios.expected: Treat mismatch as separate failure; do not file a false-positive assertion.
Check actual case/readback before any duplicate submission.
